We've had a ton of ghost towns. Mining and other extraction operations would cause a temporary regional economic influx. If the town does not stabilize enough by the time that the resources dry up then when all of the workers leave there is nothing left driving the economy and the town falls apart. But, a whole city? If one source fails it will hit the others for sure, but usually this will not cause a city wide economic meltdown.
